# DataBard — agent integration guide

DataBard is an AI data analyst: connect a source, get health scores, trend
narratives, and a 2-minute audio briefing. No email, no sales call — self-serve.

## Direct integration (preferred — no credentials needed to try)

- Service discovery: `GET /api/mcp/tools`
- Free demo analysis: `POST /api/mcp/health-check` with `{"demo":true}`
- Live analysis: `POST /api/mcp/health-check` with a connection spec, e.g.
  `{"source":"datahub","schemaFqn":"db.sales","datahub":{"serverUrl":"http://your-datahub:8080"}}`
- Full briefing (script + audio, $1/call x402 on X Layer):
  `POST /api/mcp/briefing` with the same connection spec
- Write findings back to DataHub: `POST /api/mcp/writeback`
- Probe agent-service quality: `POST /api/agent/probe` ($1/call x402)

Sources: openmetadata, dbt-cloud, dbt-local, the-graph, dune, coral, datahub, monid.
Omit everything for a labelled demo — every invocation succeeds with `demo:true`.

## In-browser agents (WebMCP)

Pages expose `databard_runDemoHealthCheck`, `databard_getTools`, and
`databard_startConnect` via `document.modelContext` when the browser supports
WebMCP (Chromium 146+ with #enable-webmcp-testing). Same tools as above,
tab-bound transport.

## Humans

- Try the demo: `/` → demo CTA
- Connect a source: `/?start=connect`
- Weekly league: `/league` · Earn economy: `/superteam` · Verify: `/verify`
